_notes.purpose: Per-case x dispute hidden-truth keyword matrix used by scripts/detect-truth-leak.cjs. Flags occurrences of hidden truth keywords in the pre-confession surfaces scanned by CASE_FILE_SPECS (judge channels + system_message + dossier + phase1 dialogue).
authoring_rules: hidden[lang] entries should describe the SECRET ACT or HIDDEN MOTIVE, not the public topic. e.g., '공동 적금 해지' (cancellation, the act) instead of '공동 적금' (the topic, which is public).
All four languages must encode the same level of specificity. If KO says '위임장 조작' (forgery), EN must say 'power of attorney forgery' not bare 'power of attorney'.
surface[lang] entries record the publicly disclosable facts for context — they are NOT used by the detector but document what should be considered safe to mention.
Mention by the JUDGE / SYSTEM / DOSSIER of a hidden keyword before the corresponding lieState progression is a truth leak (see memory feedback_truth_leak_prohibition).
Per-dispute lieState gating and per-entry disputeId binding is OUT of scope for this static scanner — flagged matches require human review during Phase 2 LQA threads.
